title: Quandale Dingle Farted
blurb: Four words that require no further explanation and would not survive one. The Quandale Dingle universe grew out of a screenshot of a school computer displaying an improbable name, and it expanded into hundreds of absurd micro-narratives, each more committed to the bit than the last. It has characters. It has catchphrases and an internal logic nobody outside it can follow. This clip is a complete short story. Use it as a status update, a formal accusation, or the entirety of your contribution to a group chat. Quandale did what he did.
origin: From the Quandale Dingle meme universe.
